headline: Turkey Credit Card Spending Growth Slows to Five-Year Low
summary: The annual growth rate of credit card spending in Turkey decelerated to 32.9% in the week ending October 30, 2026, marking its lowest level since 2021.
why: Credit card spending trends reflect domestic consumer demand and the impact of monetary tightening on retail activity in Turkey.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Slowing credit card spending growth indicates cooling domestic consumer consumption.
